text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm visiting a racecourse today to inspect
it for
<chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I've heard the good news, Oguri! Looks
like
they're having an event to mark the
release of
your plushie! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Your family must be so proud of their
little star!
I'd love to get the scoop on
their heartwarming
reaction. When are
they available for an
interview?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Well, my parents are back in my
hometown, so—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I don't mind talking over the phone!
Sooo, if
you would just tell me your
family's phone
number...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Th-their number? Um, it's zero—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Interview or not, asking for personal
information
is unacceptable. As a
member of the academy, I
can't stand
idly by.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Huh, and who might you be? Th-that
badge...
Haha, you must be from the
academy, eh? Well,
I'll be on my way,
then!
choice_data_list: Please direct any further questions through the academy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for saving me. I had a feeling
that
reporter didn't have good
intentions.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know...
choice_data_list: If something feels fishy, turn it down right away.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But that reporter called me a star.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And he told me that stars have an
obligation to
respond because that's
what their fans would
want.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I thought if I refused to answer...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'd be letting everyone down. Is
that not
true?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear she regards her fans highly...
but that
makes what I'm about to say all
the more
important.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list: You need to turn them down properly.
You have to turn them down properly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: Your fans want to cherish you too.
Your fans want to cherish you too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Tome and Shige used to
always tell
me I was their treasure.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I guess that means I should protect
myself... so I
can protect their treasure.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I see where you're coming from.
I'll make
sure to refuse next time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if I'll really be able to do it
properly,
though.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, I'll do that.
choice_data_list: Turn to an adult when that happens.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll be counting on you when the
time comes.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The way you handled the
conversation
earlier was very impressive.
Plus, you just happen
to be from the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So... Could I ask for your help again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taken aback by her frank request.
Everything
she said is true, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've heard. My mom often praised
me for it.
choice_data_list: You can be a little too honest sometimes.
You have a habit of being a little too honest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later on, I see Oguri Cap candidly
asking other
adults in the academy
various questions.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...A special phrase?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's... exactly what you told the
reporter!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And the reporter ran off the second they
heard
those words. Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as she finishes speaking, a woman
runs over
to us.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are, Oguri! About the
plushie—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Please contact the academy regarding
that
question!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Wait, what?! Weren't we scheduled
to have a
meeting about manufacturing
your plushie today?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh. Yes, that's right... S-sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seems like it'll take a little more work
before she
can use her special phrase
properly.
